Whether it’s for your home or office, opaque window film offers an excellent solution for enhancing privacy without sacrificing natural light. An opaque window film is one of the most effective and convenient ways to add more privacy to your home or office by adding a small layer of vinyl over the windows.

Our range of opaque glass film for windows and doors provides a host of benefits along with added privacy for your space. In this article, we provide you with information on the best window film options for privacy offered by Australia’s most trusted home tinting specialist.

What is Opaque Window Film?

In the past when a homeowner or business owner wanted to make the windows in their property opaque, they would have to remove their regular pane windows and install frosted glass windows in their place. However, now you can easily tint the windows by adding vinyl window film to windows that are already installed.

Opaque window tint is essentially a thin layer of polyester or vinyl film, applied directly to the glass. It obscures visibility through the windows while still allowing light to pass through. This makes it an ideal solution for spaces that benefit from natural light but require privacy, such as private offices or bathrooms.

Different Types of Opaque Window Tints

We offer different levels of opaque glass film for windows, catering to different needs and style preferences:

  • Frosted Window Film: This is our most popular option for property owners, beloved for its ability to mimic the elegant look of etched glass at a fraction of the cost.
  • Decorative Patterns: Choose from a range of designs, including faux glass blocks and more intricate patterns, to add character and style to your windows without losing the benefits of privacy.
  • Privacy Films: These are designed specifically to prevent visibility into or out of a room, making them perfect for high-privacy areas such as meeting rooms or ground-level windows.
  • Security Films: As well as increasing privacy these films are more durable with up to 7 times the thickness of conventional tinting options. In addition to commercial buildings, these are a great option for families as shattered glass is held together by the film, reducing the chance of injury from accidental breakages.
